query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients) AS clients,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tools) AS tools,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions) AS transactions,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions) AS total_revenue,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoiceNumber) FROM transactions WHERE invoiceNumber IS NOT NULL) AS unique_invoices,
  (SELECT MIN(transactionDate) FROM transactions) AS first_date,
  (SELECT MAX(transactionDate) FROM transactions) AS last_date;
